verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The design now explicitly explains why an existential `solidx:inDoc` guard and document-qualified intermediates over untagged triples are insufficient, requires per-triple provenance or loader-minted document-qualified triples for P3, retains shared-subject dependency edges until that hardening lands, and mandates a non-vacuous split-authorization RED-then-GREEN regression. The phased dependencies and fallback posture remain conservative, and uncertainties (including unanalysed ODRL interaction) are disclosed as prerequisites rather than claimed solved. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the diff-scoped design record.
